title: Generation of kidney organoids from human pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Prepare a gelatin solution by mixing 0.1% gelatin in PBS and autoclaving it.
Mix 89% DMEM high glucose, 10% fetal bovine serum, 1% GlutaMAX supplement, and 0.5% penicillin/streptomycin to prepare FDMEM.
Prepare KSR medium by mixing 77.8% DMEM/F-12, 20% knockout serum replacement, 1% NEAA, 1% GlutaMAX, 0.5% penicillin/streptomycin, and 0.2% 2-mercaptoethanol (55 mM) and filtering it.
Feed 40 mL of KSR medium to 10 million mouse embryonic fibroblasts in a T175 flask for one day.
Collect the medium from the T175 flask after feeding with KSR medium for another day.
Repeat the process of feeding with 40 mL of KSR medium and collecting the medium six times, then pool and filter the collected medium by Stericup-GP.
Prepare APEL medium by supplementing a bottle of STEMdiff APEL (100 ml) with 0.5 ml of antibiotic-antimycotic solution.
Coat a T25 flask with 3 mL of 0.1% gelatin solution and incubate it at 37°C for 30 min.
Thaw frozen vial of mitotically inactivated mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) by warming the vial at 37°C until a small ice pellet remains.
Add pre-warmed 5 mL FDMEM dropwise to the thawed MEFs and gently mix, then collect into a 15 mL tube and centrifuge at 400 xg for 3 min.
Remove supernatant and resuspend MEFs in FDMEM.
Seed MEFs onto a T25 flask at 12,000 cells per cm² in FDMEM and culture overnight in a 37°C CO₂ incubator.
Thaw frozen vial of iPSC/hESC onto a prepared T25 flask containing mitotically inactivated MEFs by warming at 37 °C until a small ice pellet remains.
Add pre-warmed 5 mL KSR medium to the vial drop wise and gently mix.
Centrifuge the mixture at 400 xg for 3 min.
Remove supernatant and resuspend iPSC/hESC in KSR medium containing 10 ng/mL bFGF.
Seed onto flask and culture in a 37 °C CO2 incubator for 4 days.
Daily, aspirate spent KSR medium and replenish with 5 mL fresh KSR medium containing 10 ng/mL bFGF.
Aliquot 3 mL of cold DMEM/F-12 into a 15 mL tube.
Add 25 μL of hESC qualified Matrigel to the DMEM/F-12, mix well, and transfer into a T25 flask.
Keep the flask at room temperature for at least 30 min to allow Matrigel to coat the surface.
Wash cells in T25 flask with 3 mL PBS twice.
Add 2 mL TrypLE Select to cells and incubate at 37 °C for 3 min.
Pipette 5 mL DMEM/F-12 to cells, mix, and ensure cells have lifted off from the plastic surface.
Collect cell suspension at a 1:3 split ratio in a 15 mL tube and centrifuge at 400 xg for 3 min.
Remove supernatant and add 5 mL MEF-conditioned KSR medium containing 10 ng/mL bFGF to cells. Mix gently.
Aspirate Matrigel-containing DMEM/F-12 from prepared T25 flask and seed cells.
Culture in a 37 °C CO₂ incubator for 2 days.
Daily, aspirate spent MEF-conditioned KSR medium and replenish with 5 mL fresh MEF-conditioned KSR medium containing 10 ng/mL bFGF.
Wash T25 flask with 3 mL PBS twice.
Add 2 mL TrypLE Select to cells and incubate at 37 °C for 3 min.
Pipette 5 mL DMEM/F-12 basal medium to cells, mix and ensure cells have lifted off from the plastic surface. Pipette cells no more than twice as they hESC/iPSC are very sensitive.
Collect cell suspension into 15 mL tube. Count cell number by hemocytometer.
Calculate cell suspension volume to achieve 375,000 cells.
Aliquot cells into a 15 mL tube. Centrifuge at 400 xg for 3 min.
Resuspend cells in 4 mL of MEF-conditioned KSR medium containing 10 ng/mL bFGF. Seed cells into a T25 matrigel coated flask (final 15,000 cells per cm²) and culture at 37 °C overnight.
For a freshly opened APEL bottle (100 mL), add 0.5 mL of Antibiotic-Antimycotic.
Reach 40-50% confluence of cells in T25 flask.
Aspirate MEF-conditioned KSR medium from T25 flask.
Add 4 mL of APEL containing 8 μM CHIR99021 to the cells.
Culture at 37 °C for 2-5 days, refreshing the medium every 2 days.
Aspirate spent APEL containing CHIR99021 from T25 flask.
Add 6 mL of APEL containing 200 ng/mL FGF9 + 1 μg/mL Heparin to cells.
Culture at 37 °C until day 7, refreshing the medium every 2 days.
Aspirate the culturing medium and wash with 3 mL PBS.
Aspirate the PBS.
Add 1 mL trypsin EDTA (0.25%) to the cells.
Incubate at 37 °C for 3 min.
Monitor under the microscope to ensure all cells have lifted off from the surfaces.
If necessary, gently pipette the cells with trypsin and place back into the incubator for further 2 min.
Neutralize the trypsin with 9 mL of FDMEM.
Aliquot the entire culture into a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the cells at a speed of 400 xg for 3 min.
Aspirate the medium off until just a pellet of cells is left.
Resuspend the cells with 3 mL of APEL.
Take out 10 μL of cell suspension and perform a cell count with a hemocytometer.
Aliquot the required amount of cell suspension into a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 400xg for 2 min.
Aliquot 1.2 mL of APEL containing 5 μM CHIR99021 into the 6 well Transwell polyster membrane cell culture plate.
Pick up the pellet using a P1000 or P200 wide bore tip.
Place the pellet onto the transwell filter with minimal medium carry over.
Incubate pellets at 37 °C for 1 h.
After 1 h, remove the medium of APEL containing 5 μM CHIR99021.
Use 1.2 mL of APEL containing 200 ng/mL FGF9 + 1 μg/mL Heparin.
Culture for 5 days with refreshing the FGF9 medium every two days.
Change the medium of FGF9-containing APEL to APEL only after 5 days.
Culture the organoids for further 6 to 13 days in APEL only medium with refreshing the APEL every two days.
Harvest kidney organoids for further experiments.
